# Groundwork

> Groundwork is a free, ungated AI readiness system for owners and operators of small and mid-sized businesses. Six layers, built in three phases, produce fifteen plain-text documents your business owns; then one scoped AI Operator goes to work on top of them. Foundation first. Agents later.

Groundwork was built by Adam Abdalla, an operator in Lafayette, Louisiana who runs a 27-unit shopping center and built the system for his own businesses before publishing it. Everything on this site is open: no signup, no paywall, no gated downloads, no prices. The only call to action is a free AI readiness audit.

The six layers are Identity, Knowledge, Governance, Continuity, Measurement, and Operating Rhythm. Inside Layer 2 sits Authority Classification: the only named, graded document-authority system built for non-technical owners, in plain files you own. Its grading logic descends from the Admiralty Code, the source-reliability system used in naval intelligence.

## Start here

- [Day One](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/day-one.html): your first 30 minutes, scorecard first, then your first document
- [The Readiness Scorecard](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/scorecard.html): 24 questions, scored in your browser, nothing collected or transmitted
- [Guide overview](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/): the whole system on one page, with every chapter linked

## The Curriculum

The Groundwork Curriculum is the capability program beside the doctrine: five LEVELS of skill you climb as a person or team, distinct from the six LAYERS you build once for a business. The two axes never map one to one.

- [The Curriculum](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/): the hub, with the doctrine-versus-curriculum map
- [The Reader](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/read/): the whole curriculum readable on the site, one page per module, compiled verbatim from the repo
- [Level 1: Essentials](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/level-1.html): thirty days from novice to competent power user
- [Level 2: Intermediate](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/level-2.html): agents, RAG, MCP servers, evals, cost control
- [Level 3: Advanced](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/level-3.html): shipping AI to real users and keeping it standing
- [Level 4: Professional](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/level-4.html): leading AI teams, training, safety, red-teaming
- [Level 5: Frontier](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/level-5.html): contributing to the field
- [Curriculum repo](https://github.com/OrangeOnyx/groundwork-curriculum): the living version, MIT licensed, credit Jake Van Clief
- [The Curriculum as one book](https://github.com/OrangeOnyx/groundwork-curriculum/releases/latest/download/Groundwork-Curriculum.pdf): 613 pages, illustrated, bookmarked, printable
